description: HARLOW D1 (block 233000) -- attachment sociology as rules riding the REAL emotion framework (drives.json drive system + modulators.json/affective_state_core.json regulator). An infant EmotionHub -has_regulator-> ModulatorState carries the drive system's contact_comfort / hunger / distress Drives (has_active_drive). The infant -cares_for-> two Mother figures: a CONTACT-COMFORT mother (provides_contact=1) and a FEEDING mother (provides_feed=1). The VALUE of approaching a mother is the REGULATOR RELIEF it provides, read from the real drives: a contact mother relieves the contact drive (weight*urge) PLUS buffers the active threat/distress channel (the secure base -- distress.arousal_contrib, which ONLY contact buffers); a feeding mother relieves hunger (weight*urge). The infant's approach_target is the Argmax over cared-for mothers by approach_value (hl_select_initial_target / hl_switch_target, mirroring affective_state_core's psi_select/psi_switch leading-drive selection). Attachment is thus a CONSEQUENCE of the regulator depending on the comfort bond: because contact decays and only contact buffers threat, the contact mother dominates proximity and is the flee target under stress -- Harlow (1958), contact comfort load-bearing, NOT feeding. Ablating the contact drive (no has_active_drive edge) leaves only the hunger value, inverting the preference to the feeding mother -- the falsifier. NO agent decision in Python: the value computation and the Argmax approach choice are these rules; the world adapter only publishes world facts (which mother provides what, time, stress) and tallies proximity mechanically. Integer/float-native, NO Rust, NO new Term. OFF by default: every rule guards on ModulatorState.enabled the adapter sets only on opt-in. drive_kind numeric tag: 1=contact, 2=hunger, 3=distress.

microtheory.name: harlow_attachment
microtheory.description: Infant attachment is not reducible to feeding; contact comfort is the load-bearing variable (Harlow 1958). The bond emerges because the security regulator (arousal/valence/securing over the drive system) is stabilised by the contact drive -- which decays continuously and alone buffers threat -- so the contact mother is preferred in proximity and fled to under stress. Remove the contact drive and the preference follows feeding instead.
